subject: Social Media
title: After Social Media
description: A quick, practical guide to After Social Media.

hook.text: Gen Z is quitting public posting. They use group chats, BeReal, and close-friends lists. The feed era may end.

buildup.text: Public posting peaked. Fatigue set in. People want smaller, trusted circles—not broadcast to strangers.

discovery.text: Discord servers, private Instagrams, and group chats are where real connection happens. Public is performance.

twist.text: Platforms fight this trend because private sharing is harder to monetize. Ads need public data to target.

climax.text: The future may look like the past: small groups, shared interests, real conversations. Full circle.

punchline.text: Social media started small. It may end that way too.

quiz.question: Why are platforms worried about the shift to private sharing?
options: Private sharing is harder to monetize
